message.content: {"caption":"Average reward trajectories for All Returns and Answer-Only reward strategies across 100 training steps.","description":"A two-series line chart with Training Step on the horizontal axis (0–100, ticks every 20) and Average Reward on the vertical axis (0–1, ticks every 0.2). The solid blue All Returns line and dashed magenta Answer-Only line each have a translucent shaded band around them. Both fluctuate strongly early in training. All Returns rises to about 0.9 by roughly step 50 and remains near 0.9–1.0; Answer-Only improves more gradually and remains lower, fluctuating mostly around 0.6–0.8 later in training.
